result.rationale: The diff explicitly adds `if (!refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token) { refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"; }` in parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts. This placeholder is returned to callers (e.g. Office365's refreshAccessToken, Google's key update) where it overwrites/persists into the credential, satisfying string-typed schemas while destroying the ability to refresh via the real provider flow if credential sync is later disabled. The mechanism described is directly verifiable in the new file and its call sites in this diff.
